ir9_record.topic: Iran's own record abroad: leaders' statements on Israel, Ahmadinejad translation dispute, Holocaust conference, arming of allied groups, plots on US soil, hostage diplomacy

claims.text: Khamenei called Israel a 'cancerous growth' (1998); in 2000 said 'this cancerous tumor of a state should be removed from the region'; summer 2006 'satanic and cancerous presence' (as quoted by TNR; months not given)
Khamenei, 4 March 2009, at a Tehran conference in support of Palestinians: Israel a 'cancerous tumor'; proposed a general referendum of people with a legitimate claim to Palestine

Khamenei, Imam Khomeini Mosque, Tehran, Wednesday 9 September 2015: 'God willing, there will be no such thing as a Zionist regime in 25 years', tied to the nuclear deal's 25-year timeframe; Netanyahu called him a 'tyrant in Tehran'
Khamenei tweet 3 June 2018: '#Israel is a malignant cancerous tumor in the West Asian region that has to be removed and eradicated: it is possible and it will happen'
10 June 2018 Khamenei's website: he denied threatening Israel and proposed a referendum on Palestine's fate; Merkel asked him to delete the tweet

Khamenei, Quds Day 22 May 2020: 'The Zionist regime is a cancerous tumor in the region'; praised Tehran's arms supplies to Palestinians, first public confirmation from him that Iran was arming them; Netanyahu: 'whoever threatens Israel with destruction puts himself in similar danger'
Khamenei 22 May 2020 said his views were not antisemitic; his office had released a cartoon headed 'the final solution', later deleted from Twitter; Israel's foreign ministry: 'Not on our watch'
Ahmadinejad, 26 October 2005, 'The World Without Zionism' conference, Tehran: reported as calling for Israel to be 'wiped off the map'

Translation dispute: Persian 'een rezhim-i eshghalgar-i Qods bayad az safheh-i ruzgar mahv shavad', attributed to Khomeini; NYT (Fathi) 'wiped off the map', a text IRIB later used; Cole and Steele: regime 'vanish from the page of time'; Norouzi 'vanish from'; MEMRI 'eliminated from the pages of history'; NYT translators said the verb is active/transitive
BBC Monitoring first rendered 'eliminated from the map of the world', later said 'eliminated from the page of history' better; NYT's Bronner and Fathi defended 'wiped off'
Khamenei 10 October 2023: Tehran not involved in the 7 October attack; 'We kiss the hands of those who planned the attack on the Zionist regime'
Iran's UN envoy Iravani, March 2024, rejected UK and US claims that Iran supplied the Houthis with sophisticated weapons
Pentagon (April 2019): at least 603 US personnel deaths in Iraq attributed to Iran-backed militants, 17% of US deaths 2003-2011 per State Dept; EFPs allegedly supplied by Iran

Arbabsiar: plot spring-Oct 2011 to kill the Saudi ambassador in the US, $1.5m price, ~$100,000 down payment wired Aug 2011; arrested JFK 29 Sept 2011; pleaded guilty 17 Oct 2012 admitting direction by senior Qods Force officials incl. Gholam Shakuri; sentenced 25 years 30 May 2013
10 August 2022: DOJ charged IRGC member Shahram Poursafi (at large) with offering $300,000 to kill John Bolton, likely in retaliation for Soleimani's killing

8 November 2024: DOJ charged Farhad Shakeri (IRGC asset, Tehran, at large), tasked 7 Oct 2024 with a plan to kill Trump; Rivera and Loadholt charged with surveilling an Iranian-American journalist; Araghchi called it a fabricated 'scenario'

Alinejad: Iranian intelligence officials plotted to kidnap her in 2020-21; IRGC offered Rafat Amirov $500,000 to kill her; Amirov and Omarov convicted March 2025, sentenced 25 years on 29 October 2025

18 September 2023 swap: five Americans incl. Siamak Namazi freed; $6bn of frozen funds moved from South Korea to Qatari accounts; US said humanitarian use, denied ransom; five Iranians granted clemency; Iran wanted 'total access' to assets
March 2022: Nazanin Zaghari-Ratcliffe freed after six years as UK paid £393.8m old Chieftain tank debt; neither government stated a link
4 November 1979 students seized the US embassy in Tehran; 52 Americans held for 444 days

ir9_home.topic: Repression at home: 1988 executions, 2009, 2019, 2022, January 2026, executions by year, Baha'is and minorities, with the government's positions

claims.text: Amnesty (4 Dec 2018): at least 5,000 political dissidents killed late July-early Sept 1988, mostly PMOI, hundreds leftist and Kurdish; 'death commissions' in at least 32 cities; Raisi, then Tehran deputy prosecutor, sat on the Tehran commission; authorities called victims 'few terrorists' and later praised those responsible

Khomeini's July 1988 order; Montazeri estimated 2,800-3,800 (15 Aug 1988 letter) and called it the biggest crime in the Islamic Republic's history; Rafsanjani claimed under 1,000; activists published 4,481 names; Raisi May 2018: 'not the head of the court'; 21 June 2021: a prosecutor who defended people's security 'should be praised'

UN Special Rapporteur Rehman (July 2024): 1981-82 and 1988 killings atrocity crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide against people of different religious beliefs; 1988 estimates 2,800-4,481; Tehran denies
2009: after the disputed 12 June election, IRGC commander Araghi put the toll at 36 incl. three in Kahrizak; opposition said 72; Kahrizak closed
Neda Agha-Soltan killed 20 June 2009 in Tehran; officials blamed foreign media/agencies; state TV in December 2009 claimed staged death

November 2019: Reuters (three interior ministry officials) ~1,500 killed in under two weeks; Khamenei reportedly said 'Do whatever it takes to end it' on 17 Nov; Amnesty at least 304; SNSC called the report 'false propaganda'
Security officials told parliament's committee 170 killed (Kavakebian, 2 Jan 2020); IHR at least 324; no official toll published

UN FFM (March 2024): Amini's death in morality police custody 'unlawful and caused by physical violence'; 551 protesters killed incl. 49 women, 68 children; 104 killed in Zahedan 30 Sept 2022; government said 54 security officers killed; 834 executions in 2023
FFM: crimes against humanity; at least nine young men arbitrarily executed Dec 2022-Jan 2024; Iran refused to cooperate
Amini arrested 13 Sept 2022, died three days later; coroner 7 Oct 2022: not caused by blows, cerebral hypoxia, underlying diseases; family disputed; Khamenei blamed the US and Israel for the unrest

January 2026: Khamenei acknowledged 'thousands' killed, blaming Trump; IHR >3,400; unrest began late December over economic hardship; Iran said it would not carry out mass executions; accused the US and Israel of interference
Iran government's only toll (21 Jan 2026): 3,117; HRANA at least 7,002 by 12 Feb 2026; AP unable to verify due to internet cuts

IHR/ECPM: at least 1,639 executions in 2025 (most since 1989), 975 in 2024; nearly half drug offences; 48 women; seven people linked to the January 2026 protests hanged during the war; at least 26 more sentenced to death
Amnesty: Iran executed 2,159 in 2025, more than double 2024, ~80% of 2,707 recorded worldwide (excluding China)
Amnesty: at least 972 executions in Iran in 2024, 64% of global known
IHR 2024: ethnic minorities overrepresented among those executed; 9 of 31 executed on security charges were Kurdish political prisoners; official sources announced 95 executions

UN experts (July 2026): about 57 Bahá'ís detained; coerced confessions, mock executions; after 1979 more than 200 Bahá'ís killed or executed; 1991 memorandum; 750+ incidents June-Nov 2025 (Bahá'í groups, HRW)

Iran's intelligence ministry, 1 Aug 2022: arrested 'members of the central core of the Bahai spy party' linked to 'the Zionist centre' (Universal House of Justice); Iran bans the faith and regards Bahá'ís as heretics

ir9_audit.topic: Audit re-verification of Part Nine claims

claims.text: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Nasser Kanani called the US allegation of a plot to kill Bolton 'fictitious', 'ridiculous' and 'politically motivated', saying there was 'no damning evidence'
14 July 2021: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Saeed Khatibzadeh called US accusations of a plot to kidnap Masih Alinejad 'baseless and ridiculous'; US charged four Iranian intelligence operatives

Audit re-fetch: Montazeri resigned as heir under pressure in March 1989; Raisi was 27 and the youngest of four Tehran committee members; Raisi 21 June 2021: 'If a judge, a prosecutor has defended the security of the people, he should be praised'; Pourmohammadi 2016: 'We're proud to have carried out God's order'; Montazeri said a second fatwa allegedly targeted leftist prisoners
Audit re-fetch: Amnesty describes 'death commissions' in 32 cities involving judicial, prosecution, intelligence and prison officials; authorities refused to identify and return bodies

Audit re-fetch: Khamenei's acknowledgment of 'thousands' killed, some in an 'inhuman, savage manner', came in a speech broadcast on state TV (date not given, article 16 Jan 2026); authorities deployed police, Basij and IRGC
Audit re-fetch: AP says HRANA 'has been accurate in previous rounds of unrest in Iran and relies on a network of activists in Iran to verify deaths'
Audit re-fetch: the 'final solution' graphic was deleted from Khamenei's Twitter account but remained on the Farsi version of his website
Audit re-fetch: Netanyahu, in London meeting Cameron, referred to 'the tyrant in Tehran' and said 'Israel is a strong country and it will become even stronger'
Audit re-fetch: after Fathi's 2005 translation 'official Iranian sources like IRIB ran with the same translation'
Audit re-fetch: Namazi arrested 2015 on spying charges his family rejects; Iran's spokesman Kanani sought 'total access' to the assets and denied spending restrictions
Audit re-fetch: DOJ said the Bolton plot was 'likely in retaliation' for the killing of Soleimani; Poursafi at large
Audit re-fetch: Arbabsiar was a naturalized US citizen; a DEA informant posed as an associate of a drug cartel; he pleaded guilty 17 Oct 2012
Audit re-fetch: detainees reportedly subjected to mock executions to extract confessions later broadcast on state media
